screen.title: Definitions
screen.subtitle: A clear guide to the terms used in Birthcode.

intro.title: How to read this
intro.body: Use these definitions as a legend for the map. They help you read the profile without technical noise. The goal is reflection and better decisions — not prediction. If a term feels technical, treat it as a label for a pattern, not a verdict about who you are.

what_is_birthcode.title: What is Birthcode?
what_is_birthcode.body: Birthcode translates chart patterns into practical self-reflection: language for needs, stress responses, and strengths — plus small practices you can use in daily life.

big_three.title: Big Three
big_three.body: The Big Three is a practical starting layer: Sun (identity and direction), Moon (emotional needs and regulation), and Ascendant (first-contact style — how you enter new situations).
big_three.sun: Sun: identity, direction, and what feels meaningful to build.
big_three.moon: Moon: emotional needs, regulation patterns, and recovery.
big_three.ascendant: Ascendant: first impression and your default way of starting.

degrees.title: Degrees
degrees.body: Each sign spans 0°–29°. Degrees show where a placement sits inside the sign. We simplify this as Early (0–9°), Mid (10–19°), or Late (20–29°). It refines interpretation, but it’s not required for the core profile.

planets.title: Planets
planets.body: Planets represent psychological functions: drive, bonding, communication, focus, ambition. A planet’s sign shows the style of that function.

aspects.title: Aspects
aspects.body: Aspects describe how two functions interact. Some feel supportive and smooth; others create tension. Tension isn’t bad — it often points to a growth edge.

orb.title: Orb
orb.body: Orb is how close an aspect is to exact. Smaller orb usually feels stronger. We use it to prioritize what is most noticeable.

dominants.title: Dominants
dominants.body: Dominants summarize overall tone. Element describes energy style; modality describes how you move through change. This is a quick map — not a fixed label.

elements_modalities.title: Elements and Modalities
elements_modalities.body: Elements describe your energy style (Fire/Earth/Air/Water). Modalities describe how you act on change (Cardinal/Fixed/Mutable).

insights.title: Insights
insights.body: Insights are reflection prompts based on stable patterns. They help you name triggers, needs, and choices without pathologizing.

practices.title: Practices
practices.body: Practices are small, repeatable exercises. They translate your profile into behavior: clarity, regulation, and relationships.

saved.title: Saved
saved.body: Save insights and practices so you can return to them quickly.

disclaimer.title: Note
disclaimer.body: This content is reflective and educational, not medical or psychological advice.
